manifest_row.title: At the Convergence of Climate Change and Art

screening.main_topic: An interview with artist and climate scientist Jill Pelto about using data art to communicate climate research and environmental change.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change and its impacts are discussed throughout, including glacier decline, warming, fires, sea-level rise, ocean temperature variability, and effects on ecosystems. The interview also explores public communication and engagement around climate science.
screening.reason: Climate change is a central subject of the interview, not merely background: Pelto describes her climate research, the impacts she has observed, and her work communicating climate data through art.
